text_a: Usted debe firmar el formulario antes de salir.
text_b: Tienes que firmar el formulario antes de salir.

text_a: She will send the invoice to the client on Monday.
text_b: He will send the invoice to the client on Monday.
what_differs: Different person sends the invoice (she vs he).

text_a: Ela pediu que o relatório fosse revisado hoje.
text_b: Pediram que o relatório fosse revisado hoje.
what_differs: A specific woman made the request vs an unspecified 'they'; may or may not be the same requester.

text_a: Each user must reset their password every 90 days.
text_b: Every user has to reset his or her password every 90 days.

text_a: Revisa tu correo antes de la reunión.
text_b: Revisa su correo antes de la reunión.
what_differs: 'su' can mean formal 'your' (same) or 'his/her/their' (someone else's email).

text_a: Please update our shared calendar with your vacation dates.
text_b: Please update your shared calendar with our vacation dates.
what_differs: Possessives swapped: whose calendar and whose vacation dates are reversed.

text_a: Guarde o seu crachá na gaveta ao sair.
text_b: Guarde o crachá na sua gaveta ao sair.
what_differs: Possessive moves from the badge to the drawer: your badge in a drawer vs a badge in your drawer.

text_a: Nuestro equipo entregará el informe el viernes.
text_b: El informe lo entregará nuestro equipo el viernes.

text_a: The store closed at 9 pm.
text_b: The store closes at 9 pm.
what_differs: Single past event vs habitual closing time.

text_a: El sistema cerró la sesión por inactividad.
text_b: La sesión fue cerrada por el sistema debido a inactividad.

text_a: A farmácia fechou às 22h ontem.
text_b: Ontem a farmácia encerrou às 22h.

text_a: Acme closes its Lima office.
text_b: Acme closed its Lima office.
what_differs: Headline-style present may report a past event (same) or describe a current or planned action.

text_a: Coloca el logo encima del nombre de la empresa.
text_b: Pon el nombre de la empresa debajo del logo.

text_a: Coloca el botón de cancelar a la izquierda del de guardar.
text_b: Coloca el botón de guardar a la izquierda del de cancelar.
what_differs: Left/right order of the two buttons is reversed.

text_a: Remova o segundo item a partir do fim da lista.
text_b: Remova o segundo item da lista.
what_differs: Second from the end vs second from the start.

text_a: Insira a tabela depois do segundo parágrafo.
text_b: Insira a tabela antes do terceiro parágrafo.
what_differs: Same position only if nothing (heading, figure) sits between paragraphs 2 and 3.

text_a: The report is not available until Friday.
text_b: The report is unavailable until Friday.

text_a: El pedido incluye envío sin costo.
text_b: El pedido tiene envío gratuito.

text_a: This feature is not unsupported on Android.
text_b: This feature is unsupported on Android.
what_differs: Double negation: text_a says it is supported; text_b says it is not.

text_a: O uso de celular não é proibido na sala.
text_b: O uso de celular é permitido na sala.
what_differs: 'Not prohibited' may mean merely tolerated rather than explicitly permitted.

text_a: El disco está casi lleno.
text_b: El disco está completamente lleno.
what_differs: Almost full vs completely full.

text_a: The tank is barely half full.
text_b: The tank is just under half full.
what_differs: 'Barely half' is at or just above half; 'just under half' is below half.

text_a: O servidor está totalmente configurado.
text_b: O servidor está completamente configurado.

text_a: Los resultados son muy buenos.
text_b: Los resultados son extremadamente buenos.
what_differs: Intensity differs (very vs extremely); whether that matters depends on the reader.

text_a: El precio es de 100 euros con IVA incluido.
text_b: El precio es de 100 euros más IVA.
what_differs: VAT is included in the 100 vs added on top of the 100.

text_a: The quoted total of $1,200 excludes shipping.
text_b: Shipping is not included in the quoted $1,200 total.

text_a: O salário bruto é de 5 mil reais.
text_b: O salário, antes dos descontos, é de 5 mil reais.

text_a: The fee is $50, taxes included.
text_b: The fee is $50 all-in.
what_differs: 'All-in' may also cover other charges (shipping, service fees) that 'taxes included' leaves open.

text_a: Please send me the contract ASAP.
text_b: Please send me the contract as soon as possible.

text_a: Envíame el informe cuando puedas.
text_b: Envíame el informe de inmediato.
what_differs: No deadline (at your convenience) vs immediate.

text_a: Precisamos da aprovação hoje, se possível.
text_b: Precisamos da aprovação hoje, sem falta.
what_differs: Soft preference vs hard, non-negotiable deadline.

text_a: Responda até sexta-feira.
text_b: Responda até o fim da semana.
what_differs: End of week may mean Friday (work week) or Sunday.

text_a: Please close ticket 4123.
text_b: Please close ticket 4132.
what_differs: Different ticket number (transposed digits).

text_a: Instala la versión 2.1 del cliente.
text_b: Instala la versión 2.10 del cliente.
what_differs: Version 2.1 and version 2.10 are different releases.

text_a: The meeting is in room 4B.
text_b: The meeting is in Room 4-B.

text_a: El pedido n.º 00873 ya fue enviado.
text_b: Order #873 has already been shipped.

text_a: Haz el respaldo de la base de datos esta noche.
text_b: Respalda la base de datos esta noche.

text_a: Restore the backup database.
text_b: Restore the database backup.
what_differs: Restoring a secondary database vs restoring from a backup file of the database.

text_a: Envía la plantilla del informe al equipo.
text_b: Envía el informe de la plantilla al equipo.
what_differs: Send the report template vs send a report about the template.

text_a: Ligue para o atendimento ao cliente.
text_b: Ligue para o serviço de atendimento ao cliente.
